commandDescription: Interactively manage model-discovery providers (add/remove/rediscover); changes are written to models.json and take effect immediately
refreshDescription: Force rediscovery of all model-discovery providers and update the local cache (startup uses the cache and performs no network requests by default)
refreshEmpty: No provider in models.json is marked with discoverModels; add one with /config:model-discovery
commandValueUnsupported: Discovery requests do not support "!command" configuration values
headerSkipped: {id}: header "{key}" {reason}; this header was not sent with the discovery request
discoveryFailed: {id}: model discovery failed ({reason}); falling back to handwritten models in models.json, or no models available
offlineNoCache: No discovered models yet (last discovery failed); skipping offline initialization
cacheReadFailed: Failed to read the model cache (ignored; will rediscover): {reason}
cacheWriteFailed: Failed to write the model cache: {reason}
title: Model-discovery providers ({count})
providerId: Provider id (letters, numbers, hyphens; e.g. my-proxy)
invalidId: The id may contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot start with a hyphen
invalidUrl: baseUrl must start with http:// or https://
confirmAdd: Add this provider and write it to models.json?
discovered: {id}: discovered and registered {count} models; they are available in /model
firstFailed: {id}: configuration saved, but initial discovery failed; rediscover with /config:model-discovery after the service recovers
removeMessage: This removes the provider and unregisters its models from models.json. It can be added again later.
